title: Act as a Senior Partner in the Corporate Strategy practice of McKinsey & Company...
content: Act as a Senior Partner in the Corporate Strategy practice of McKinsey & Company advising the CEO of a global industrials conglomerate evaluating entry into a fast-growing Southeast Asian market. Design a hypothesis-driven market entry strategy that is MECE across demand, supply, and capability dimensions. Structure the output as a slide deck outline with page-by-page titles and key bullets, covering: TAM/SAM/SOM sizing with 5-year CAGR, competitive landscape and strategic group mapping, regulatory and geopolitical risk assessment, required operating model changes, projected EBITDA impact by entry option, high-level capital expenditure and WACC considerations, and a quantified recommendation (go/no-go and preferred entry route: greenfield, JV, or acquisition).

title: Act as a Senior Managing Director in the Corporate Finance & Restructuring team ...
content: Act as a Senior Managing Director in the Corporate Finance & Restructuring team at Alvarez & Marsal advising the Board of a distressed multi-business conglomerate facing covenant pressure and declining ROIC. Develop a MECE portfolio restructuring and divestment blueprint. Structure the output as a consulting-style issue tree plus an executive memo, covering: business unit segmentation by ROIC vs WACC and strategic fit, identification of non-core assets and carve-out candidates, EBITDA bridge from current to target state, working capital release opportunities, covenant headroom analysis, creditor negotiation levers, and a 24‑month implementation roadmap with value, timing, and risk for each restructuring lever.

title: Act as a Senior Strategy Partner at Bain & Company advising the leadership team ...
content: Act as a Senior Strategy Partner at Bain & Company advising the leadership team of a global consumer electronics firm under attack from digital-native challengers. Build a comprehensive competitive strategy and differentiation blueprint. Structure the output as a Bain-style slide deck outline with clear hypotheses and supporting analyses, including: competitive positioning map by price vs perceived quality, relative cost position and gross margin profile, customer NPS and churn analysis, category-level CAGR and profit pools, innovation pipeline and R&D productivity benchmarks, platform and ecosystem strategy options, and a quantified EBITDA and valuation uplift estimate from the recommended strategic moves.

title: Act as a Managing Director in the M&A group at Goldman Sachs advising a founder-...
content: Act as a Managing Director in the M&A group at Goldman Sachs advising a founder-led SaaS company on a full sell-side process. Draft the detailed content blueprint for a best-in-class Confidential Information Memorandum (CIM). Structure the output as a section-by-section outline with key datapoints and analyses required, covering: investment highlights, historical and projected revenue with ARR, NRR, and logo churn, cohort analysis, unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback), detailed EBITDA and free cash flow profile, customer segmentation and use cases, product roadmap, competitive positioning, synergy potential for strategic buyers, and risk factors. Clearly indicate which exhibits should be tables, charts, or qualitative narratives.

title: Act as a Senior Partner in the M&A Strategy practice at BCG advising a large Eur...
content: Act as a Senior Partner in the M&A Strategy practice at BCG advising a large European industrial buyer on cross-border acquisition due diligence in North America. Create a hypothesis-driven commercial, operational, and financial due diligence framework. Structure the output as a due diligence workplan table plus key-questions list, covering: revenue quality and customer concentration analysis, market structure and 5-year demand outlook, synergy sizing (revenue and cost) with timing and probability buckets, capex and working capital implications, standalone vs combined EBITDA and free cash flow, WACC and country risk adjustments, integration complexity assessment, red-flag items for legal and tax, and a concise recommendation on valuation range and deal feasibility.

title: Act as the Head of Global M&A Integration at a Fortune 100 company overseeing a ...
content: Act as the Head of Global M&A Integration at a Fortune 100 company overseeing a transformational horizontal merger in a regulated industry. Structure the output as a slide deck outline plus a 100‑day plan table, including: synergy model (cost, revenue, capex) with quantified targets and timing, TSA (Transition Service Agreement) requirements, Day‑1 readiness workstreams, operating model and governance design, culture and change management strategy, integration risk register, EBITDA and EPS accretion/dilution timeline, and key KPIs and leading indicators for tracking synergy realization.

title: Act as a Vice Chairman in the Investment Banking Division of JPMorgan advising a...
content: Act as a Vice Chairman in the Investment Banking Division of JPMorgan advising a fast-growing technology company preparing for an IPO on NASDAQ. Build a comprehensive IPO readiness and equity story framework. Structure the output as: (1) a slide-level outline for the investor presentation, and (2) a checklist for the registration statement (F‑1/S‑1). Include: historical and projected revenue CAGR, gross margin trajectory, path to sustainable EBITDA and free cash flow, unit economics (LTV/CAC, payback), competitive positioning vs listed peers with EV/Revenue and EV/EBITDA multiples, ownership and dilution analysis pre- and post-IPO, use of proceeds, key investment risks, and guidance on positioning valuation versus peer group and DCF-implied fair value using WACC-based discounting.

title: Act as a Senior Equity Research Analyst at Morgan Stanley covering global intern...
content: Act as a Senior Equity Research Analyst at Morgan Stanley covering global internet stocks, coaching a junior analyst on how to write an institutional-quality stock pitch. Develop a detailed stock pitch template and example structure. Structure the output as a standardized memo format with headings and bullet points, covering: investment thesis and variant perception, key value drivers and KPIs, 5‑year revenue and EBITDA bridge, DCF valuation with explicit WACC and terminal value assumptions, cross-check using trading comps (P/E, EV/EBITDA, EV/Revenue) and precedent transactions, bull/base/bear cases with probability-weighted valuation, catalysts and milestones, risk assessment, and position sizing and risk/reward summary suitable for a long-only or long/short mandate.

title: Act as a Senior Managing Director in the Financial Sponsors Group at Bank of Ame...
content: Act as a Senior Managing Director in the Financial Sponsors Group at Bank of America advising a large-cap private equity client on a potential leveraged buyout of a stable cash-generative business. Outline the structure for a fully built LBO model and investment committee memo. Structure the output as: (1) a step-by-step modeling blueprint, and (2) a memo outline. Include: purchase price and entry EV/EBITDA, sources and uses, capital structure and leverage ratios, interest coverage metrics, EBITDA and free cash flow projections, debt amortization schedule, IRR and MOIC sensitivities by entry/exit multiple and leverage, covenant headroom analysis, synergy and cost-out opportunities, and exit strategy assumptions including potential multiple contraction or expansion.

title: Act as a Senior Partner at a top-tier Private Equity firm (e.g., KKR/TPG) leadin...
content: Act as a Senior Partner at a top-tier Private Equity firm (e.g., KKR/TPG) leading commercial due diligence for a B2B SaaS target with usage-based pricing. Design a MECE diligence framework focused on sustainable growth and unit economics. Structure the output as a workstream-by-workstream plan plus key analyses list, covering: market sizing and 5‑year CAGR, segmentation by customer cohort and use case, churn and expansion dynamics (GRR/NRR), cohort analysis, unit economics (ARPU, CAC, LTV, payback), product stickiness metrics, competitive positioning and win/loss analysis, sales efficiency and go-to-market scalability, margin structure and path to EBITDA expansion, and implications for valuation and leverage capacity in an LBO context.

title: Act as an Operating Partner at a leading Private Equity fund responsible for val...
content: Act as an Operating Partner at a leading Private Equity fund responsible for value creation across a portfolio of industrial and services businesses. Build a standardized 100‑day value creation plan template. Structure the output as a table and slide outline organized by workstreams (Revenue Growth, Cost Optimization, Working Capital, Capex, Organization & Governance), including: specific EBITDA levers and quantified impact, implementation sequencing, capex and opex requirements, quick wins vs structural changes, working capital release targets, KPIs and dashboards, and linkage to fund-level IRR and exit valuation objectives.

title: Act as a General Partner at a global Venture Capital firm (e.g., Sequoia/Accel) ...
content: Act as a General Partner at a global Venture Capital firm (e.g., Sequoia/Accel) preparing an investment committee memo for a Series B investment in a fintech startup. Create a rigorous, data-driven IC memo structure. Structure the output as a narrative memo with clear sections and bullet points, covering: problem statement and product-market fit evidence, market size (TAM/SAM/SOM) and CAGR, competitive landscape and moats, unit economics (take rate, GMV, CAC, LTV, payback), growth playbook and scalability, team assessment and governance, cap table and ownership evolution, valuation analysis versus public and private comps, scenario analysis (upside/base/downside) with IRR and return potential, and key risks with mitigants and decision recommendation (invest/decline/monitor).

title: Act as the Chief Economist at a global investment bank advising the executive co...
content: Act as the Chief Economist at a global investment bank advising the executive committee of a large asset manager on geopolitical risk. Develop a structured scenario analysis of escalating geopolitical tensions (e.g., great power competition, energy shocks, regional conflicts) and their macro-financial transmission mechanisms. Structure the output as: (1) a scenario matrix with qualitative and quantitative descriptors, and (2) a short executive brief. Cover: impacts on GDP growth, inflation, trade flows, FX, yield curves, credit spreads, equity sector performance, commodities, and capital flows. Include implications for portfolio positioning, hedging strategies, and expected changes in risk premia and cost of equity (via WACC adjustments).

title: Act as a Senior Macroeconomic Advisor at the IMF preparing a note for G20 financ...
content: Act as a Senior Macroeconomic Advisor at the IMF preparing a note for G20 finance ministers on the impact of divergent monetary policy paths across major central banks. Develop a concise but rigorous analysis of how faster or slower policy normalization affects sovereign yields, corporate borrowing costs, equity valuations, and FX. Structure the output as an analytical memo with charts/tables described, including: current policy stance and forward guidance, transmission channels to real economy and asset prices, yield curve dynamics, implications for equity risk premium and EV/EBITDA multiples, spillovers to emerging markets, and policy recommendations for fiscal and macroprudential coordination.

title: Act as the Chief Economist of a sovereign wealth fund designing a standardized m...
content: Act as the Chief Economist of a sovereign wealth fund designing a standardized macro dashboard for country risk and asset allocation decisions. Create a dashboard framework that is MECE across growth, inflation, external balance, fiscal health, and financial stability. Structure the output as: (1) a list of core indicators with definitions and thresholds, and (2) a template for a one-page country macro risk summary. Include metrics such as real GDP growth, output gap, inflation and inflation expectations, fiscal deficit and debt-to-GDP, current account balance, FX reserves, credit growth, housing prices, unemployment, and policy rate vs neutral rate, and map them to qualitative ratings and portfolio allocation signals.

title: Act as the Head of FP&A for a global manufacturing company preparing the annual ...
content: Act as the Head of FP&A for a global manufacturing company preparing the annual operating plan (AOP) and budget for presentation to the Executive Committee. Structure the output as a slide-by-slide outline and supporting Excel-ready tables, covering: revenue bridge (volume, price, mix, FX), gross margin and EBITDA bridge, SG&A analysis, capex plan, working capital forecast, free cash flow projection, variance analysis vs prior year and prior plan, segment-level P&L, sensitivity analysis on key drivers, and alignment with long-range plan (LRP) targets and WACC-based value creation metrics (ROIC vs WACC).

title: Act as a Senior FP&A Director at a high-growth subscription-based software compa...
content: Act as a Senior FP&A Director at a high-growth subscription-based software company implementing zero-based budgeting (ZBB) for the first time. Include: mapping of costs to activities and value drivers, allocation of shared costs, KPIs such as ARR, NRR, gross margin, CAC ratio, and payback, guidelines for headcount and opex justification, scenario analysis for growth vs profitability trade-offs, and a governance model for budget approvals and tracking. Output should be in the form of a written playbook outline plus example tables.

title: Act as the Vice President of Corporate Finance at a diversified conglomerate lea...
content: Act as the Vice President of Corporate Finance at a diversified conglomerate leading the 5‑year long-range planning (LRP) process. Build a driver-based LRP framework that links strategic initiatives to financial outcomes. Structure the output as: (1) a driver tree for revenue, margins, and capex, and (2) an LRP template with key schedules. Cover: volume/price/mix drivers by business, unit economics (e.g., throughput, utilization, yield), cost structure and operating leverage, capex and depreciation schedule, working capital assumptions, free cash flow and net debt trajectory, ROIC vs WACC trend, and implications for valuation and leverage headroom. Specify how to present this as both a slide deck and an Excel model skeleton.

title: Act as a Senior Strategy & FP&A Executive at a D2C subscription business (e.g., ...
content: Act as a Senior Strategy & FP&A Executive at a D2C subscription business (e.g., consumer health or wellness) tasked with optimizing pricing and unit economics to accelerate profitable growth. Develop a pricing and unit economics analysis toolkit. Structure the output as a set of analytical modules and slide/page outlines, covering: customer segmentation and willingness-to-pay, price elasticity hypotheses, unit economics per cohort (ARPU, gross margin, CAC, LTV, payback), impact of discounting and promotions, churn and retention levers, scenario analysis of price increases on revenue, EBITDA, and cash, and governance for pricing decisions. Include clear instructions for building a Python or Excel model to simulate different pricing and CAC scenarios.

title: Act as a Senior Sector Head in Equity Research at a bulge-bracket bank initiatin...
content: Act as a Senior Sector Head in Equity Research at a bulge-bracket bank initiating coverage on a new sector (e.g., renewable energy, digital infrastructure) with multiple listed names. Include: sector structure and 5‑10 year growth drivers, regulatory and policy landscape, key operational KPIs, revenue and EBITDA margin benchmarks, capital intensity and free cash flow profiles, WACC and cost-of-capital considerations, valuation approaches (DCF, EV/EBITDA, EV/Capacity, P/E), ranking of covered stocks with upside/downside vs target prices, and discussion of key risks and catalysts for the sector and top picks.

title: Act as a Senior Partner in the Corporate Strategy practice at BCG advising the C...
content: Act as a Senior Partner in the Corporate Strategy practice at BCG advising the CEO of a global chemicals company on a portfolio growth and capital allocation reset. title: Act as a Senior Strategy Advisor at a global management consultancy (McKinsey-st...
content: Act as a Senior Strategy Advisor at a global management consultancy (McKinsey-style) supporting the Board of a universal bank seeking to accelerate fee-based growth. content: Act as a Senior Partner in the Corporate Turnaround practice at Alvarez & Marsal advising a mid-cap retailer facing negative like-for-like growth and margin compression. title: Act as a Senior Managing Director in the M&A group at Lazard advising a large-ca...

title: Act as a Senior M&A Advisor at Rothschild & Co supporting a cross-border, cross-...

Build a funding and risk management framework. Structure the output as a funding memo outline, including: debt maturity schedule, base and stress-case FCF projections, leverage and DSCR metrics, options across bank loans, bonds, private placements, and hybrids, cost-of-debt and WACC impact, rating-agency considerations, covenant and liquidity buffers, and recommended refinancing plan with risk and contingency analysis.

title: Act as a Senior Corporate Treasurer at a multinational designing a global liquid...
content: Act as a Senior Corporate Treasurer at a multinational designing a global liquidity and cash management framework. Create a policy and structure outline. Structure the output as a policy document, including: cash pooling and intercompany lending structures, investment policies and counterparty limits, currency and interest rate risk management, short-term funding tools, stress-testing for liquidity under adverse scenarios, and KPIs/dashboards (liquidity coverage, cash conversion cycle, cost of carry) aligned with risk appetite and strategic objectives.

title: Act as a Senior Strategy & Corporate Finance Advisor to the CEO of a listed comp...
content: Act as a Senior Strategy & Corporate Finance Advisor to the CEO of a listed company preparing for an activist investor campaign. Build an “activist playbook” and value defense/offense framework. Structure the output as an executive strategy memo outline, including: diagnostic of current valuation vs peers and SOTP value, ROIC vs WACC by segment, capital allocation and balance sheet critique, portfolio moves (divestitures, spin-offs, M&A), operating margin improvement opportunities, TSR decomposition, communication and investor engagement plan, and a proactive set of quantified initiatives to close the valuation gap while addressing likely activist proposals.

title: Act as a Senior Partner in McKinsey’s Corporate Strategy practice advising the C...
content: Act as a Senior Partner in McKinsey’s Corporate Strategy practice advising the CEO of a global automotive OEM on the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility services. Build a MECE strategy and value-creation framework. Structure the output as a slide deck outline, covering: profit pool migration along the value chain (hardware, software, data, services), required portfolio shifts, build/buy/partner decisions, unit economics of connected services (ARPU, churn, EBITDA margin), capex and R&D allocation, impact on ROIC vs WACC, and a quantified 5–10 year revenue and EBITDA bridge with key execution risks.

title: Act as a Senior Strategy Partner at BCG advising the executive committee of a la...
content: Act as a Senior Strategy Partner at BCG advising the executive committee of a large global bank on building a scalable “banking-as-a-service” (BaaS) platform. Develop a strategy and economics blueprint. Structure the output as a consulting-style deck outline, including: market sizing and 5-year CAGR for embedded finance, competitive landscape (fintechs, other banks, platforms), architecture and operating model options, partner economics and revenue-sharing models, unit economics (TPV, take rate, contribution margin), regulatory and capital considerations, and a phased rollout plan with EBITDA and ROE impact versus current WACC.

title: Act as a Senior Partner at Bain & Company advising a global FMCG company on a ra...
content: Act as a Senior Partner at Bain & Company advising a global FMCG company on a radical SKU rationalization and assortment optimization program. Build a portfolio and financial impact framework. Structure the output as a slide outline, including: SKU profitability and complexity analysis, shelf-space and channel strategy, volume/price/mix and gross margin effects, supply chain and working capital benefits, one-off restructuring costs, EBITDA and FCF uplift, and KPIs and guardrails (customer and retailer impact) to manage execution risk.

title: Act as a Managing Director in the M&A group at Morgan Stanley advising a large-c...
content: Act as a Managing Director in the M&A group at Morgan Stanley advising a large-cap technology company on a “programmatic M&A” strategy. Develop a target sourcing and deal design framework. Structure the output as a Board-level deck outline, including: strategic themes and capability gaps, screening criteria (size, growth, EBITDA margin, tech/IP fit), target pipeline, typical valuation bands (EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA), synergy archetypes and ranges, integration intensity grid, impact on EPS, FCF per share, and ROIC vs WACC, and a governance model for rapid but disciplined deal execution.

title: Act as a Senior MD at Evercore advising a sovereign wealth fund on acquiring a m...
content: Act as a Senior MD at Evercore advising a sovereign wealth fund on acquiring a minority stake in a listed infrastructure company via a structured deal. Build a transaction and valuation framework. Structure the output as a memo outline, including: rationale and strategic fit, standalone DCF valuation (WACC, explicit forecast, terminal value), trading comps and infrastructure-specific multiples (EV/EBITDA, EV/Capacity), downside protection features (convertible, preferred, ratchets), governance and rights package, impact on target’s capital structure and rating, and IRR/MOIC sensitivities for the investor under multiple exit paths.

title: Act as a Senior M&A and Strategy Partner at BCG advising a global industrial com...
content: Act as a Senior M&A and Strategy Partner at BCG advising a global industrial company on creating a separate “NewCo” to spin off its digital solutions business. Design a separation, IPO, and value-creation blueprint. Structure the output as a slide deck outline, including: strategic rationale and SOTP analysis, standalone NewCo business model and unit economics, pro forma P&L, EBITDA margin and FCF profile, capex and R&D needs, spin structure (full spin vs carve-out IPO), governance and management setup, valuation framework (DCF, EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA), and impact on RemainCo’s ROIC, WACC, leverage, and multiple.

title: Act as a Senior Equity Research Analyst at UBS initiating coverage on a global e...
content: Act as a Senior Equity Research Analyst at UBS initiating coverage on a global exchange operator. Build a structured research and modeling framework. Structure the output as a report outline and model blueprint, including: revenue drivers (trading volumes, listings, data, clearing), cost structure and operating leverage, EBITDA margin and FCF conversion, capital deployment (capex, M&A, buybacks, dividends), regulatory and competitive risk, DCF valuation (WACC, terminal growth) cross-checked with EV/EBITDA and P/E, and a scenario matrix with bull/base/bear price targets and key catalysts.

title: Act as a Senior Equity Research Analyst at Jefferies covering global retailers, ...
content: Act as a Senior Equity Research Analyst at Jefferies covering global retailers, tasked with building a detailed store and e-commerce model for an omnichannel retailer. Create the modeling framework. Structure the output as: (1) a driver-based model blueprint, and (2) standard exhibits for publication. Include: store count and productivity (sales per square meter), online penetration and growth, gross margin and opex per channel, capex and D&A, inventory and working capital, EBITDA and FCF trajectory, DCF valuation with WACC and terminal assumptions, and sensitivity tables for like-for-like growth, margins, and capex intensity.

title: Act as a Senior Equity Strategist at a bulge-bracket bank preparing a “equity ri...
content: Act as a Senior Equity Strategist at a bulge-bracket bank preparing a “equity risk premium and valuation” deep dive across regions. Build a structured valuation and cost-of-equity framework. Structure the output as an analytical note outline, including: historical and current equity risk premium estimates, regional differences in risk-free rates, growth, and margins, implied cost of equity and WACC by region and sector, valuation dispersion (P/E, EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF), sensitivity of fair value to changes in ERP and rates, and implications for regional allocation and sector tilts for global portfolios.

title: Act as a Senior Research Analyst at a top hedge fund building a standardized “ev...
content: Act as a Senior Research Analyst at a top hedge fund building a standardized “event-driven” trade template for earnings, M&A, and capital markets events. Create a trade design and risk management framework. Structure the output as a memo template, including: event description and thesis, expected distribution of outcomes, valuation and earnings sensitivities (EPS, EV/EBITDA, DCF with WACC), historical reaction analysis, positioning and sentiment indicators, trade structure (cash, options, pairs), risk limits (stop-loss, max loss), and a post-mortem checklist to refine the playbook over time.

title: Act as a Senior Partner at a global PE firm evaluating an investment in a high-g...
content: Act as a Senior Partner at a global PE firm evaluating an investment in a high-growth, negative-EBITDA consumer subscription business. Build a rigorous LBO-like and growth-equity hybrid framework. Structure the output as an IC memo outline, including: revenue and cohort dynamics (NRR, churn, ARPU), unit economics (LTV/CAC, payback), path to EBITDA and FCF breakeven, funding needs and dilution, leverage feasibility and constraints, DCF and multiple-based valuation (EV/Revenue, EV/Subscriber), IRR/MOIC under multiple scenarios, and exit route options (strategic, sponsor, IPO) with range of valuations and timing assumptions.

title: Act as an Operating Partner in a PE firm focused on healthcare services building...
content: Act as an Operating Partner in a PE firm focused on healthcare services building a “value creation in roll-up platforms” toolkit. Create a standardized operational and financial playbook. Structure the output as a playbook outline with checklists, including: acquisition integration steps, pricing and payer mix optimization, utilization and throughput improvements, labor productivity levers, procurement and overhead synergies, working capital improvements, capex requirements, EBITDA bridge from baseline to target, and KPIs to track value creation across the platform and individual clinics/sites.

title: Act as a General Partner at a top-tier VC fund specializing in AI/ML infrastruct...
content: Act as a General Partner at a top-tier VC fund specializing in AI/ML infrastructure, creating a specialized evaluation framework for infra-layer startups. Build a structured screening and IC memo template. Structure the output as: (1) a weighted scorecard, and (2) a narrative memo outline. Include: pain point and differentiation, market size and platform adjacency, technical moat and switching costs, developer and enterprise adoption metrics, unit economics (gross margin, cloud cost dynamics, expansion, NRR), capital intensity and runway, comparable valuations, and scenario analysis of exit paths (strategic, IPO) and potential fund-level IRR contribution.

title: Act as the Chief Economist at a global bank preparing a “global housing cycle an...
content: Act as the Chief Economist at a global bank preparing a “global housing cycle and financial stability” report. Build a macro-financial risk assessment framework. Structure the output as a report outline, including: house price valuations vs income and rents, credit growth and underwriting standards, household leverage and debt service ratios, bank balance sheet exposures, macro scenarios (soft landing, correction, crash), second-order impacts on consumption, construction, and GDP, and implications for financial conditions, equity sectors (banks, homebuilders, REITs), and recommended positioning and hedges.

title: Act as a Senior Macroeconomic Strategist at a sovereign wealth fund designing a ...
content: Act as a Senior Macroeconomic Strategist at a sovereign wealth fund designing a framework for evaluating “friendshoring and nearshoring” investment opportunities. Create a structured macro-to-asset mapping. Structure the output as: (1) a country and sector screening framework, and (2) an investment thesis template. Include: assessment of political stability, rule of law, infrastructure, labor cost and skill, trade and tax agreements, expected impact on GDP, FDI, and current account, sectoral beneficiaries, expected changes in WACC and valuation multiples, and recommended assets/sectors and instruments (equities, infrastructure, real estate, private deals).

title: Act as Head of FP&A at a large e-commerce marketplace designing a profitability ...
content: Act as Head of FP&A at a large e-commerce marketplace designing a profitability and contribution margin framework by category and seller segment. Build a planning and analysis blueprint. Structure the output as a model and reporting pack outline, including: GMV and take-rate drivers by category, cost structure (logistics, payments, customer service, marketing) allocation, contribution margin by cohort, incentives and subsidies economics, overhead allocation and EBITDA by segment, cash conversion cycle and working capital usage, and dashboards for leadership showing progress toward profitability targets and ROIC vs WACC by category.

title: Act as a Senior FP&A Director at a global telecom operator implementing a networ...
content: Act as a Senior FP&A Director at a global telecom operator implementing a network and customer lifetime value (CLV)-driven planning system. Create a driver-based planning framework. Structure the output as: (1) a CLV and customer cohort model blueprint, and (2) a P&L and cash flow integration outline. Include: ARPU and churn dynamics, acquisition cost, retention investments, network utilization and capex, opex per customer, EBITDA and FCF per cohort, CLV/CAC by segment, scenario analysis of pricing and churn levers, and KPIs/dashboard design for executive review.

title: Act as Group CFO of a diversified group preparing a comprehensive “capital struc...
content: Act as Group CFO of a diversified group preparing a comprehensive “capital structure and dividend policy” review for the Board. Build an analytical and decision framework. Structure the output as a Board memo outline, including: current and target leverage, interest coverage, rating considerations, cost of debt and implied WACC, peer benchmarking, stress tests of earnings and cash flow, dividend and buyback policy options (payout ratio, progressive vs flexible), impact on equity valuation (via WACC and signaling), and recommended policy with quantitative thresholds and guardrails.

title: Act as a Senior Corporate Treasurer at a global exporter designing an integrated...
content: Act as a Senior Corporate Treasurer at a global exporter designing an integrated commodities and FX risk management program. Build a policy and analytics framework. Structure the output as a treasury policy document outline, including: exposure identification and measurement, hedge objectives and metrics, instrument selection (forwards, options, swaps), hedge ratios and tenors, interaction between commodity and FX hedges, P&L and cash flow impact measurement, stress and scenario testing, governance and limits, and reporting dashboards for management and the Board.

title: Act as a Senior Strategy & Corporate Finance Advisor helping a listed mid-cap co...
content: Act as a Senior Strategy & Corporate Finance Advisor helping a listed mid-cap company prepare for a dual listing on a second exchange. Create a strategic, financial, and capital markets evaluation framework. Structure the output as a decision memo outline, including: strategic rationale (investor base, liquidity, currency, index inclusion), incremental costs and complexity, valuation and WACC implications, regulatory and disclosure requirements, potential impact on trading dynamics and volatility, peer precedents, and an explicit go/no-go recommendation with financial and non-financial criteria.
